subject.title: fix(agents): do not treat zero-exit exec success as tool failure

question: Do supported tool-event producers guarantee that `details.ok`, `details.success`, zero `exitCode`, and statuses `completed`, `ok`, `success`, or `0` are authoritative success signals even when `evt.isError` is true?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes error-state precedence for every tool result using these generic fields; the remaining question is contract scope rather than a demonstrated local defect.

options.title: Confirm the producer contract before merge
options.body: Verify the accepted success fields against current producer implementations and retain the broader helper only when each signal is contractually terminal success.

options.title: Narrow success recognition
options.body: If status-only or boolean success markers are not authoritative across producers, limit the override to proven signals such as a numeric zero exit code and add producer-contract regressions.

recommendation.title: Confirm the producer contract before merge
recommendation.body: Verify the accepted success fields against current producer implementations and retain the broader helper only when each signal is contractually terminal success.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the helper and supplied the current proof, so they are best placed to provide the first producer-contract trace for maintainer review.
